name: 更新日時を添えたフォルダー行
prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup
Asset type: Lighthouse Japanese component catalog redesign candidate, LH15-0001 only.
Primary request: Redesign the single existing folder row shown in image 1, preserving its compact one-row structure and EXACT Japanese content. Show one component on pure white, no device, no page chrome, no presentation annotations.
Input images in supplied order: 1 = our FigCraft component preview, the content/layout authority; 2 = original Google Drive source screenshot, use ONLY its Work folder row to recover the recognizable folder silhouette and horizontal three-dot overflow control, do not import page chrome or English; 3 = owner-approved bus design, style guidance for restrained white surface, soft depth and rounded shape only; 4 = owner-selected category cards, fine border and outline craft only, no borrowed content or colored icon circles.
Composition: A compact horizontal white rounded row, logical width 390 px, height about 72 px. Slate folder icon left, two-line text block centrally, horizontal three-dot overflow control at far right. Keep relative anatomy of image 1. Present the entire row with modest white margins. No extra headings, buttons, chevrons, rows, badges or new features.
Text (verbatim): first line "奉仕チーム"; second line "更新 3:56". No other text. Preserve Japanese glyphs and the colon, space and numerals exactly.
Typography: Meiryo Regular 14 px / 24 px first line; Meiryo Regular 12 px / 16 px metadata, tracking 0. Preserve body weight; do not turn this row into a large bold title. Render at a uniform higher pixel scale if needed without changing hierarchy.
Official palette and materials: canvas #FFFFFF; row #FFFFFF; ink #1D1D1D; metadata #6E6E6E; folder and more dots coherent slate #526173; subtle neutral border, very soft downward shadow, restrained rounded corners. Crisp consistent icon edges. No broad mint, no tinted icon tile, no gloss or glow.
Accent decision: The source folder row is neutral gray and carries no selected/status/category accent. The mock's green folder is decorative. Adapt it to slate; omit an extra accent because the visible state has no semantic selection or primary CTA. Forest green is reserved for primary actions, but this row contains none, so do not invent one.
Constraints: Preserve the actual folder identity and overflow affordance, both exact text lines and their alignment. No gradients on this neutral row. No Google logo or source watermark. No English, IDs, captions or labels outside the component. Polished compact Apple-informed hierarchy and purposeful materials; this image does not assert editable or working controls.
reviewNotes: 原図と自作プレビューを実際に開いて比較。原図の中立フォルダー形状・横三点操作を保ち、自作の装飾的な緑をスレートへ変更。生成結果を目視確認：奉仕チーム／更新 3:56、2行、フォルダー、三点を保持。白背景・微細な中立枠・柔らかい影。最新の原図優先指示は生成完了時に到着、原図と照合して重大な図形欠落なし。正確なMeiryoメトリクスはラスターから未証明、所有者承認・編集可能性・実装は未確認。
reviewNotice: 画像生成候補。ネイティブ編集・実装・所有者承認とは別です。
